decisions.invocation_semantics: No additional verified-state precondition beyond gateway parameter validation and physical preflight.
decisions.effect_semantics: Each capability must establish the requested power, brightness, or color-temperature value on the bedside lamp.
decisions.evidence_semantics: Power effects require an independent Tuya light-sensor before/after delta of at least 100 units in the commanded direction. Brightness and color-temperature effects continue to require post-invocation Yeelight readback. Provider acknowledgement is LINEAGE_ONLY.
decisions.interruption_semantics: Unverified effects block continuation; stale evidence may be reacquired once; unavailable providers may be rebound once; otherwise terminate safely.

sensor_calibration.ambient_interference: A passive on/off inference can be unknown or incorrect when other light sources change; execution verification therefore uses a directional before/after delta.
